description: This file defines a utility class LogManager used for configuring logging in the RomRaider project. It contains a method to initialize debugging logging by configuring Log4j with a properties file.

classes.name: LogManager
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to initialize logging configuration.

methods.name: initDebugLogging
methods.description: Initializes debugging logging by configuring Log4j to watch the 'log4j.properties' file.
